milestones.outcome: An authored milestone plan survives consumer intake and controls multi-card assignments and checked continuation.
exit_criteria: The supplied structured plan is discovered through the normal target entrypoint and remapped without changing milestone grouping.
A disposable linked-consumer public path carries one assignment through intermediate card completion and validates its integrated boundary before selecting the next milestone.
Coordinator, integrator and worker instructions agree on plan-first scope and replacement decisions; focused schema/helper/instruction checks pass.
milestones.boundary: The fixed authored-plan path is usable end to end before expanding legacy, partial and planless branches. Intake is part of this work, not a separate generation.

milestones.outcome: Authored, legacy and ad-hoc targets share an adaptive milestone lifecycle with verified native behavior and reusable authoring guidance.
exit_criteria: Legacy normalization, planless formation, subset projection, dependency look-ahead, amendments and recovery preserve all selected obligations.
Offline authoring examples and generated human views agree with the canonical schema; compact diagnostics expose actual continuation decisions without inventing economics.
Both bounded native courses have direct passing evidence and selected adoption/closeout is truthful. Missing required evidence prevents this milestone and the RFC from being declared complete.
milestones.boundary: The general target behavior, documentation, native proof and routine closeout belong together. Individual test, documentation or closeout cards are not reset boundaries.
